name: developer
description: Engineering team toolkit for Claude Code. Coding-quality skills used by the dev subagents: skill-frontend-web (HTML/CSS/SCSS/Tailwind/JS/TS/React), skill-backend (API/server design + controller/service/repository layering), skill-sql (schema/query/security/migration), and skill-software-testing (test design + UAT docs + QA loop). Also bundles skill-python (venv-per-project), skill-fastapi, skill-data-modeling (team data-model standard: UUID v7 / soft-delete / hand-written SQL migrations), skill-erd-dbml (ERD docs: erd.dbml + erd-readme.md for dbdiagram.io), and ui-ux-pro-max (design intelligence) — revised to the kob theme. Reuses the security plugin. Subagents: subagent-fullstack (builds per proposal/architecture using the coding skills), subagent-data-architect (schema design + ERD docs, gated by PM), and subagent-qa-tester (test + UAT + security, with a PM-mediated fix loop back to fullstack).
